context: A boss reviews corp environmental policy
purpose: Teach: ダイオキシン/隔離/葬式/解読/闘う/争う/変遷/盗ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 環境対策、ダイオキシン排出、ゼロを、目指せ。
lines.en: Environmental compliance, dioxin emissions — we aim for zero.
lines.style: Measured directive. Crisp attack on each clause. Executive clarity without harshness. The confidence of someone stating what will be, not what might be.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。隔離保管の廃棄物、適正処理、徹底しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining thorough proper disposal of all isolated waste materials.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Professional cadence. Slight emphasis on 'thorough' — showing competence without overstatement. Calm, ready to be questioned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前社長の葬式、社内、深く哀悼してくれた。
lines.en: The former president's funeral — our staff mourned him deeply, from the heart.
lines.style: Quieter register. Genuine respect underlying the words. A pause before 'deeply' — acknowledging loss. Not performative grief, but sincerely held.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い社内資料の暗号、解読、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're making progress decrypting the old internal records.
lines.style: Brief, factual update. Neutral pace. No elaboration — just the necessary information delivered without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の競争、誠実に闘う姿勢、社員に、示せ。
lines.en: Show the staff what it looks like to compete with integrity in this industry.
lines.style: Clear instruction, measured but firm. Weight on 'integrity' — this matters. Not barked, but unmistakably an expectation being set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シェアを争う場面、増えております、最近。
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more situations where we're competing for market share lately.
lines.style: Responsive observation. Slight upward inflection on 'lately' — acknowledging the trend without alarm. Practical tone, informing not warning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の変遷、新人研修で、教えろ。
lines.en: Make sure the new employee training covers how the industry has changed.
lines.style: Direct instruction, clear priority. Steady pacing. The tone of someone assigning something important but achievable. Expect compliance without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内データ、盗まれないよう、警備、徹底しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining strict security protocols so internal data stays protected.
lines.style: Confident assurance. Emphasis on 'strict' and 'protected' — anchoring accountability. Professional, no apology, implying this is already standard.
